column1: • Tissue: a peripheral ganglion (DRG, nodose/jugular, trigeminal, sympathetic, enteric, other autonomic) or a cell type sorted from one.
• Diet: hypercaloric — high-fat, Western (high fat + sucrose ± cholesterol), high-fat high-sugar/fructose, cafeteria, maternal/early-life HFD, or HFD combined with low-dose STZ.
• Assay: transcriptome-wide (bulk RNA-seq, TRAP-seq, sc/snRNA-seq, spatial, microarray).
• Excluded from main list: STZ-only or genetic models (sheet 'Non-diet models'); hypercaloric diet but non-ganglion tissue, or ganglion without a diet contrast (sheet 'Near-misses').
• No public single-cell DRG dataset with a diet contrast is currently retrievable; C1's Dryad DOI did not resolve on the search date.
• A5 (sympathetic) contains few neurons; it mainly informs glia, perineurial/endothelial and immune responses.
• Group sizes are small throughout (n = 2–8 per arm); A3 has 3 per sex per group.
• Diet composition differs across studies (45% vs 60% lard HFD vs 42% Western TD88137), as does duration (4–33 weeks).
